text: Fu Ji
Ichihime
Saber
Sakura Matou
Archer
Rin Tohsaka
Sakura...
Besides...
I've never seen you lose so badly before.
Hehe, maybe today the goddess of luck will smile on me and I'll come out on top.
Okay, I look forward to playing against you when the time comes.
As expected, Archer, you're as efficient as ever.
Fu Ji, did you confirm the target's appearance?
Yep.
S-Sure.
Shirou... It won't be long now.
It's headline news – looks like I got involved in something big, nyaa!
Yes, it was indeed very dangerous.
...Huh? Oh, yep. That's right.
After going through all this trouble, the rumor turned out to be false.
...I guess you're right.
What is it, nyaa?
Can Tohsaka senpai and I also participate in the competition held at your place during the weekend?
Now that I'm finally enjoying mahjong, I want to play it more.
Oh, that would be great, nyaa!
No problem. Thank you so much!
What is it, Sakura?
Yeah, yeah. Let's just get him first.
Shirou... I'm so glad.
Take care, nyaa!
Yes, goodbye!
Where the Journey Goes
Outside the Competition Venue
Kidnappers' Hideout
One Han City - Some Restaurant
The only thing I remember about yesterday is that we had a blast playing mahjong, nyaa! Oh, and I slept so well after all that winning, nyaa!
Um... I don't know either. I'll have to do well in the competition to lure out the kidnappers, but I'm not sure how far I can get.
But maybe yesterday's class changed something in me. I feel like I've started to enjoy mahjong a bit more, and I'm even a little excited about the competition.
It's true. I was all over the place yesterday, but it was my first time playing mahjong with Tohsaka senpai, after all...
Spotting someone acting suspiciously during the competition, tracking them to their hideout, confirming that the suspects are gathering inside, and then staying under the radar to keep watch...
Something this trivial isn't worth praising. They were just a group of ordinary people.
The people who kidnapped me were among them. They are definitely the kidnappers.
Shirou and the other hostages are most likely in there too. We just need to take down all the kidnappers and rescue the victims. I don't think we need a very detailed plan now.
I've been meaning to ask you this for a while. Are you sure you two can handle that?
If the plan is just to subdue the kidnappers, it's safer for us to take care of it. That way, there's no risk of the victims getting hurt.
Just a reminder – don't go overboard. This is the city, and there are no Overseers here.
You don't need to remind me of that. Still, I'm not planning to go easy on them – not after they kidnapped so many innocent people for their own selfish desires.
If you need a hand, you can ask that nosy red-haired kid among the victims for help.
Let's do it then, Saber. It's a shame our opponents are so weak. They aren't worthy of us teaming up.
So in the end, all the kidnappers got arrested, all the hostages were rescued safe and sound, and... half of the hideout building was blown up, nyaa!
...Yeah. The world's so huge, and there's so much we don't know. I never thought something like that, um...
Huh...? I guess so. I've never seen a gas explosion take place in front of me either.
Anyway, it's good that everything worked out in the end. Let's just forget about the gas explosion – no point in dwelling on something that's already happened.
Yes, I'm glad that senpai is safe and sound.
Chin up. We came here just to check it out. It's not like we were really expecting anything anyway.
The results, huh? How should I put it? It wasn't really a win or a loss. I guess we'll have to determine the winner next time.
It was the police. They told me that the investigation senpai stayed over to assist with is almost wrapped up, and he can come back soon.
We need to hurry and pick him up...! What should I bring for him? A change of clothes, his wallet... What else am I forgetting...
Let's go, Sakura. Who knows what else Emiya can get caught up in if we leave him alone?
...You're welcome. Take care!
I'll leave the competition to you, Ichihime, Rin, and Sakura.
Huh? Fu Ji, aren't you coming with us, nyaa?
Didn't I tell you yesterday? I saw the kidnappers' faces, so it's better for me to track them... Have you forgotten already?
I don't think anything unexpected will go down at the competition, but you should still be careful just in case.
Thank you, Saber. I hope everything goes well on your side too.
Rin, you better not get too thrilled about the competition and let your guard down.
Seriously, what sort of person do you think I am? Stop talking now and go find the kidnappers!
...This guy, I swear. Anyway, how are you, Sakura? Feeling confident?
You are a strange one. I don't get how you could start liking mahjong after what happened yesterday. Ichihime was basically the only one winning.
...Hmph, we'll see about that. If we both keep advancing, don't expect me to go easy on you when we face off.
Hey, you two! The competition is about to start, nyaa! Come quickly, nyaa!
Yes, that's right. There's no way we can mess up something as simple as this.
...Fu Ji, after we rescue the victims, please guide them out of the building as soon as possible.

Speaking of which, I still can't believe there was a gas explosion at the building you tracked the kidnappers to. It was such a close call, nyaa. Thank goodness you guys and the hostages got out early; otherwise, you could have been seriously injured, nyaa...
The victims all made it out safely thanks to Fu Ji's quick actions. Thank you very much.
Is something wrong, Fu Ji? You've seemed a bit out of it since yesterday, nyaa! Did the gas explosion really throw you off that much, nyaa?
By the way, Rin and Sakura, how did yesterday's mahjong competition go? I still haven't asked you about the results.
Oh, Miss Ichihime, can I discuss something with you?
Okay! We better practice hard since we're going to compete on the weekend! Fu Ji, you have to help us too!
Sure. As long as you pay enough Coppers, I'm more than willing to help. I promise fair treatment for all, no tricks.
Hello? Yes, hi... Yes, okay. I understand. Thank you very much.
O-Okay...! Miss Ichihime, Miss Fu Ji, thank you for helping us this time and for agreeing to my earlier request!
